title: OrgChartGenerator employees file (v1)
description: The humans of an organization, keyed by email. Permissive: unknown keys are allowed throughout.

org.description: Name of the organization. Should match the teams file; nothing enforces it.

version.description: Format version. A file of a later version will not validate against this schema.

employees.description: Employees keyed by email address. Duplicate keys are ill-formed per the YAML spec, but lenient parsers accept them and keep the last, so a validator should check for duplicates explicitly.

employee.description: An Employee. Carries 'name' plus any further attributes, including nested objects.
